review_findings.P2-1: A rejected observation stopped all later observations of the source
review_findings.P2-2: Malformed iceberg_namespace_allowlist (JSONDecodeError) or a non-finite metric value (ValueError while encoding JSON) in one source stopped the remaining sources, also through the scheduler
review_findings.P2-3: No regression test for a real duplicate canonical timestamp inside score_project

resolution.score_project: Every source is attempted. Expected source errors are logged with the full source; unexpected Exception subclasses are logged, annotated with the source and raised together as ExceptionGroup afterwards. MemoryError stops the job immediately; BaseException is not caught.
resolution.observations: invalid_history, insufficient_history and invalid_input skip only that observation with a warning; other refusals stop the remaining observations of the source.
resolution.non_finite: NaN/Infinity features and non-numeric history raise 422 invalid_history before any HTTP request.
resolution.scheduler_compatibility: collectors/scheduler.py and collectors/per_project.py already catch Exception per project; ExceptionGroup is an Exception and is logged with all sub-tracebacks.
